name: tls-mern
description: Top Local Specialists — UK healthcare specialist and facility directory

scripts.//: One command per thing a host needs. `build` produces the site the API will serve; `start` applies migrations and boots. Nothing here is specific to any one provider.
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend install --include=dev && npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend install --omit=dev
scripts.check: npm --prefix backend run smoke && npm --prefix frontend run build
